title: Continuum confinement and the static potential
statement: Give a mathematically controlled derivation of confinement for four-dimensional pure nonabelian Yang--Mills theory, for example a positive string tension for its physical continuum Wilson loops. This is the general goal already indexed as GP-1975-10. The normalized large-rank loop-equation method in 1979-482.13 is a proposed route, not an equivalent formulation or proof of the fixed-rank continuum assertion.
status: As of 10 November 2026, rigorous strong-coupling lattice results such as \citet{chatterjee2015string} are partial. They do not establish the unrestricted four-dimensional continuum assertion; see \citet{jaffewitten2000yangmills}. The old id is reused only for the explicit general confinement goal; it does not identify the large-rank method with the earlier formulation.

title: Kazhdan--Lusztig multiplicity and cohomological conjectures
statement: For a regular integral block of category \(\mathcal O\), recover Verma composition multiplicities and the graded Ext dimensions from the Kazhdan--Lusztig polynomials, with the precise antidominant indexing in occurrences 1979-483.6--7.
status: As of 10 November 2026: solved. The independent geometric proofs circulated by the 1980 Toru\'n meeting and were published in 1981; see \citet[pp.~43--44]{brylinski1981differential}, \citet{brylinskikashiwara1981holonomic}, and \citet{beilinsonbernstein1981localisation}. This status concerns complex characteristic-zero regular integral category \(\mathcal O\), not unrestricted modular analogues.
